purpose: Test the two previously omitted Jiagu-P forecast semantics separately and together on fresh E76-E80: 20-window mean-plus-trend demand ordering, forecast-sized active-prefix width, and their faithful combination; all 60 runs remain blinded until QC and pairing complete.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E76-E80 were declared in the V32 full source manifest but were never captured, referenced, executed, or inspected; E21-E75 are closed and E11-E20 remain sealed.

source.high_profile_note: Frozen high remains 7k; V33 is low only.

diagnostic_basis.closed_v32_observation: Jiagu ranked first in both low-load mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR on E71-E75; every V32 candidate failed the combined gate.
diagnostic_basis.code_audit_before_v33_capture: The Jiagu-P baseline keeps a per-function 20-frame pending-demand history, forecasts mean plus one-half endpoint trend, orders pending players by descending forecast, and uses ceil(forecast) as the active prefix width. The existing NSESche Jiagu expert used only current-window demand for both order and width.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_a_isolation: Replace only player ordering with the frozen Jiagu-P forecast while retaining current-window active-prefix width.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_b_isolation: Replace only active-prefix width with ceil(forecast) while retaining current-window player ordering.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_c_faithful_combination: Use the Jiagu-P forecast for both player ordering and active-prefix width; retain the already-mirrored container-state, utilization, task-count, projected-load, rank, and node-ID keys.

router_inputs: current pending and running task counts
per-function pending-demand history from the current and preceding at most 19 scheduling frames

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit before capture; build and run serially; reveal after all QC and pairing.

eligibility_per_candidate: mean fixed-window throughput strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
mean QPR strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
frozen V8 middle/high retain first place in both metrics
selection_rule: Freeze the first passing candidate in fixed v33c, v33a, v33b priority (faithful combined repair before isolated components); ties fail; otherwise select none and close E76-E80.

confirmation.closure_requirement: First in mean throughput and QPR for every load against frozen E11-E20 baselines.
